article.title: Сальмонелла в ресторане: как повторные опросы и история покупок помогли найти источник
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 2 журнальных страницах: краткое содержание, весь текст расследования, 1 рисунок с подписью и примечаниями, благодарности, сведения об авторах и организациях, заявление о конфликте интересов и все 3 сноски. Все 3 библиографические записи сохранены на языке оригинала. График воспроизведён без изменения данных; перевод надписей приведён под ним. Текст подготовлен по полному XML PMC и сверён с PDF издателя. Редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.license: Public domain, confirmed by article-specific PMC XML and MMWR policy
source.rights_note: Full attribution, free-source link and nonendorsement notice supplied. Publisher PDF and figure bytes preserved. Translation and editorial explanations identified separately; no CDC logo introduced.
source.status_check: Crossref has no update-to relation; XML has no retracted-article relation; PubMed and targeted DOI correction search revealed no correction or retraction of this report.

selection.reader: Food safety, HACCP, laboratory and sanitation staff at catering establishments; transferable investigation reasoning for food-industry quality staff.
selection.utility: Initial interviews missed a common exposure; iterative open-ended interviews and purchase histories identified a restaurant; composite environmental/food samples guided sanitation.
selection.limits: Historical US investigation, status through June 10, 2024. Composite positives do not prove each constituent surface positive. Introduction route not established; positive employee not proven initial source. No sanitation regimen or reopening test details supplied. No market or factory prevalence estimate.
selection.semantic_ranking: No new TypeSafe call: individual source suitability and numerical consistency review, not a batch of repeated semantic classifications.
selection.screened_alternative: Cashew brie report 10.15585/mmwr.mm7221a4 not selected: text shifts from 36 samples / 51 isolates to 51 samples; did not expand or translate it.

review.spelled_numbers: Full comparison: five initial residents; four/eight reported exposures at milestones; nine staff; seven composite environmental and two composite food positives; 11 total cases; symptom, hospitalization, nonstool and UTI counts; five incubation observations; one newly hired employee; three later patients. Figure bars sum to 11; source timeline and dates retained.
review.pdf_visual_review: All pages inspected. Full source, original figure with translated labels, distinct editorial notes and attribution preserved.
